incidents.name: Network connectivity issues affecting services in North America

incident_updates.body:
We have identified a connectivity provider outage causing network congestion and degraded performance for some customers in North America. Affected customers may experience increased latency, packet loss, and intermittent errors across multiple services.

Our network team is rerouting traffic away from affected paths, and we are working directly with our provider on restoration.

We are investigating degraded network performance affecting some traffic between our Ashburn and Atlanta data centers. 
Some customers may see increased latency, packet loss, or intermittent errors on Workers and other services in the Eastern US. 
Our network team is actively working on mitigation.

incidents.name: Delayed, missed, and duplicated Workers Cron Triggers

incident_updates.body: We are investigating reports that some Workers Cron Triggers are running late, being skipped, or running more than once. Affected customers may see scheduled Workers invocations that do not run on time or run more than once. We will post an update as we learn more.

incident_updates.body:
We will be performing scheduled maintenance in MNL (Manila) datacenter on 2026-10-23 between 18:00 and 22:00 UTC.

Traffic might be re-routed from this location, hence there is a possibility of a slight increase in latency during this maintenance window for end-users in the affected region. For PNI / CNI customers connecting with us in this location, please make sure you are expecting this traffic to fail over elsewhere during this maintenance window as network interfaces in this datacentre may become temporarily unavailable.

You can now subscribe to these notifications via Cloudflare dashboard and receive these updates directly via email, PagerDuty and webhooks (based on your plan): https://developers.cloudflare.com/notifications/notification-available/#cloudflare-status.
